bio_text: Manjot Singh is the Founder & CEO of Ajath Infotech, a mobile app and IT consulting company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Gurugram, India, serving clients across healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, and education. With over 15 years in software development, he has led Ajath to work with 200+ businesses globally, specializing in iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile solutions. He also holds an MBA and has a background spanning sales, marketing, and technical project management.
